In detail

This area around the former Leopolda station and Porta al Prato, adjoining the Fortezza da Basso, was specifically flagged in a district crime breakdown as a combined 'Leopolda-Fortezza' zone rated high-risk with organised gang presence — consistent with the Fortezza da Basso's separate inclusion in the official Prefecture 'zona rossa'. Sources checked: La Firenze che Vorrei, quartiere-by-quartiere summer crime report (Quartiere 1 data, Leopolda-Fortezza).
